Transform Any Space with Microcement

Microcement is a thin, decorative coating you can use on floors, walls, stairs, countertops, and furniture  even in bathrooms and showers. Thanks to its versatility, you can create a seamless finish throughout your entire interior.

100% Waterproof

Perfect for bathrooms, kitchens, and moisture-prone areas

Easy Maintenance

Simple to clean and requires minimal upkeep

Durable

Built to withstand daily wear and tear for years

Why Microcement is the solution for you

At KT Construction, we redefine interior spaces, crafting beautiful, unified environments that stand out from the ordinary. Our unique microcement solutions infuse every surface with unparalleled durability, versatility, and seamless elegance.

Eco Friendly

Composition consists of eco cement, minerals, water-based resins, and selected aggregates from recycled compounds

Over 1020 colors

Customize spaces with an extensive chart of combinable colors and a wide range of textures

3mm Thick

Minimum thickness (1-3mm) provides the perfect decorative solution for maximum functionality

Strong adhesion

Adapts to any surface - facades, floors, walls, ceilings, and furniture, indoor and outdoor

Fire resistance

Fire-resistant properties provide enhanced safety and protection against fire hazards

UV resistance

UV-resistant ensuring long-lasting stability and durability when exposed to sunlight

Slip resistance

Anti-slip treatment makes it a safe option for bathroom floors and various surfaces

Waterproofing

Completely waterproof surface, perfect for bathrooms where water protection is crucial

Simple 3-Step Process

1. Prepare the Substrate

A properly prepared surface is essential for achieving a strong, smooth, and long-lasting finish.

2. Apply Microcement

Microcement is applied in 2 to 6 coats, depending on the manufacturer’s warranty and the chosen design style.

3. Seal & Protect

A high-quality sealer protects the microcement from dirt, moisture, and daily wear, ensuring a durable and beautifully finished surface.

About KT Construction

Who We Are

At KT Construction, we are specialists in microcement and decorative finishes, bringing over 20 years of experience to every surface we transform. Based in our showroom in Hurstpierpoint, we are a close-knit team of craftsmen who take pride in delivering exceptional results with a personal touch.

Our passion lies in creating beautiful, durable, and bespoke finishes that elevate spaces. Whether it’s sleek microcement floors, seamless bathrooms, or unique wall textures. Over the years, we’ve built a reputation for quality, reliability, and attention to detail, working closely with homeowners, designers, and architects across the South of England.

What sets us apart is not just our craftsmanship, but our collaborative approach. We believe in clear communication, honest advice, and making sure each project reflects our clients’ vision, down to the last detail.

Whether youre renovating a home, designing a commercial space, or exploring modern surface finishes, KT Construction is here to help you bring your ideas to life with confidence and creativity.

Our Mission

At KT Construction, our mission is to bring creativity, precision and craftsmanship together to transform spaces through exceptional microcement and decorative finishes.

We are committed to providing a personal, professional service from start to finish. Whether it is a bespoke residential feature or a large-scale commercial installation, we approach every job with the same passion for design, innovation and excellence.

At KT Construction, we do not just finish surfaces, we create spaces that inspire.
